description: This Java class 'ContentServices' provides various static methods for managing content and content associations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for finding related content, traversing content trees, activating/deactivating content associations, rendering content as text, linking content to publication points, and utility functions for string manipulation and URL encoding.

classes.name: ContentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for content management operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: findRelatedContent
methods.description: Finds related content based on association types, content types, and permission checks.

methods.name: findContentParents
methods.description: Traverses content hierarchy to find parent content nodes.

methods.name: walkParentTree
methods.description: Recursively walks through content tree nodes to collect parent content IDs.

methods.name: traverseContent
methods.description: Traverses a content tree starting from a specified content ID, with date and association filters.

methods.name: deactivateContentAssocMethod
methods.description: Performs the actual deactivation of a content association with permission checks.

methods.name: deactivateAssocs
methods.description: Deactivates other active associations related to a content ID and map key.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Renders subcontent associated with a content ID and map key as text.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Renders content associated with a content ID as text.

methods.name: linkContentToPubPt
methods.description: Links or unlinks content to a publication point, managing content status and associations.

methods.name: getPrefixedMembers
methods.description: Extracts map entries with keys starting with a specified prefix.

methods.name: splitString
methods.description: Splits an input string into a list based on a delimiter.

methods.name: joinString
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string with a delimiter.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: URL-encodes a map of arguments into a query string.
